faces.transcription: Take the target City card under the objective and add it to the hand of the player who completed this objective.
faces.flavor: The Soviets were investigating a hydrogen production facility in a remote harbor outside the city: a large building built after the war. It's unclear how this relates to either production or deployment of the MEDUSA plague, but the Soviets appear to need large quantities of hydrogen.
